Chinese translations and extracted text in translations/community-wiki.json are
adaptations of the attributed Wiki source content and are provided under the same
CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license. Each entry retains source-page and revision attribution.
The Wiki article history identifies contributors. Collection dates, raw source,
revision IDs, and extraction limitations are retained in translation-review/wiki-corpus-20261023.

This supplementary data is separate from Sapphire code and from the GPL-licensed
SkyBlockZH corpus. Existing Sapphire and SkyBlockZH translations retain priority.
No endorsement by Hypixel, the Wiki, or its contributors is implied.
